The Future of the Pokémon TCG | 30th Celebration | Artist YOSHIROTTEN
The famed Japanese artist YOSHIROTTEN sits down in a short video interview with Creatures Inc. Art Director Satoru Nagaya to discuss the influences behind his artwork, his vision for the Futuristic rare, the foil Basic Energy cards found in 30th Celebration, and the expansion’s special artwork.

You’ll also see stunning visuals showcasing his past art projects and the full texture of the Mew ex, Mewtwo ex, and Basic Energy cards.
